title: Smart Lock Access Audit
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue events (`hue:event`), thermostats (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT bridged to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zigbee2mqtt:device event=lock_operation
| stats count as operations, values(user_name) as users by action
| sort - operations
description: Keeps an audit trail of every smart-lock lock and unlock with who did it, so you know exactly who came and went.
value: A lock history is reassuring and useful — it confirms the kids got home and flags an unlock you did not expect.
implementation: Bridge lock-operation events; schedule daily and alert on unlocks outside expected hours or by unknown users.
visualization: Table of lock operations by action with user names.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a record of who locked and unlocked the door and when, so you know the family got home safely.
